name: James
note: "A servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ" (1:1); traditionally James the brother of Jesus, leader of the Jerusalem church.

name: The twelve tribes in the Dispersion
note: The readers: Jewish believers (and, in a wider sense, God's people) scattered abroad (1:1).

name: The poor and humble
note: Told to glory in their high position (1:9) and honored by God (2:5).

name: The Lord Jesus Christ
note: Called "the Lord of glory" (2:1); his coming is awaited (5:7-8).

name: Abraham and Rahab
note: Examples used in the argument about faith and works (2:21-25).

name: Job and Elijah
note: Examples of patience and of prayer (5:11, 5:17-18).
